working_tree_basis: clean isolated checkout plus only the inactive cleanup proposal and maintained publisher outputs
claim_boundary: This inventory classifies current-tree control-plane surfaces for an inactive authority-reduction proposal. Counts are descriptive only and are not acceptance targets. Classification does not activate cleanup, authorize deletion, establish non-use, or provide human acceptance.

included: Tasks, graph relationships, chains, checkpoints, and ownership records
schemas, fixtures, profiles, extensions, and resource manifests
generated SQLite, SQL, manifests, Task graph, evidence inventory, and documentation
harness Python modules, CLI commands, and tests
tracked or observed cache and temporary artifacts
excluded: scientific production code, scientific evidence, and research documentation that are not direct control-plane artifacts
Pi user-global packages and configuration outside the repository
implementation, deletion, activation, dependency, release, and protected operations

surfaces.observation: The root policy is the only AGENTS.md in the clean isolated tree; its retained operational authority and procedural routing require consumer and duplication review.
Each retained role must be durable, operational, and distinct; phase-specific or unconsumed roles are cleanup candidates.
Each retained skill must have a current consumer and distinct capability.
Canonical skill resources and the maintained project template require resolver or operational consumers; synchronized live skill copies are runtime projections of retained authority.

surfaces.selection_rule: active, architecture_corrected_awaiting_human_review, blocked, deferred, deferred_inactive, or inactive
surfaces.observation: This count includes the inactive cleanup Task. Retention still requires a current or prospective operation and relationship; status alone does not prove necessity.

surfaces.selection_rule: completed, accepted, authorized-pass, legacy-recorded, closed, or superseded statuses
surfaces.observation: Completed and superseded records are cleanup candidates because Git preserves their history; they need not remain live merely as ceremony.
The count includes planned, active-pending-acceptance, and awaiting-human-review chains; each must still prove current operational necessity.
Closed chains are candidates for removal from live control state because Git retains their history.
No unresolved checkpoint exists. Resolved and superseded checkpoints need not remain tracked as live control state.
Retain only if current ownership validation consumes these contracts.
The six task-specific manifests describe completed work and are candidates for removal from the current tree.
Retain only while it is reproducible by the maintained publisher and consumed as a projection rather than authority.
Historical evidence may be deleted from the current tree because Git preserves it; any current consumer must be identified before removal.
Every retained resource, schema, profile, fixture, and descriptor requires a current resolver or profile consumer.
Aliases, adapters, compatibility extensions, schemas, fixtures, profiles, and manifests without live consumers are removal candidates.
Generated state must have one maintained synchronization path and remain exact with canonical sources.
Archived duplicates may be deleted without creating another archival layer because Git preserves history.
These inputs govern the active parent and its inactive proposed successor.
This is current planning documentation, not generated authority or activation.
Existing reports require consumer review; historical or superseded reports need not remain tracked merely for ceremony.
Production modules are evaluated by domain ownership and behavior, never against numerical line or module targets.

surfaces.target: One synchronization command, one source-aware validation command, and additional CLIs only for distinct maintained user operations; no wrapper-only CLI and no command-output parsing between maintained commands.

surfaces.observation: Tests are evaluated by represented behavior and evidence ownership, not reduced to meet a numerical target.
Generated Task pages are projections; authored operational documentation must have a current consumer and must not duplicate authority.

The initial structural inventory confirms no individual compatibility file as removable without consumer analysis; the activated audit must identify aliases, adapters, wrappers, schemas, fixtures, profiles, extensions, and documentation with no live consumer.
No copied cache or temporary state exists in the clean isolated inventory. The target invariant is that none remains tracked.
No whole structural surface lacks an initial classification; individual consumer and disposition decisions remain for the inactive audit.

target_invariants: Only durable, operational agent roles remain live.
Only operational current or future Tasks and relationships remain in the live Task catalog; completed or superseded Task history does not remain live merely as ceremony.
Only currently operational chains remain live.
Resolved checkpoints do not remain tracked as live control state.
Historical evidence and archived duplicates may be deleted from the current tree because Git preserves their history.
Current generated evidence projections remain only when reproducible by the maintained publisher.
No tracked cache, temporary database, journal, staging, backup, or replay output remains.
Every retained skill has a current consumer and distinct capability.
Every retained CLI has a current user story not already covered by another command.
Every retained resource has a current resolver or profile consumer.
Aliases, adapters, compatibility wrappers, schemas, fixtures, profiles, extensions, and documentation without a live consumer are removed.
Each control domain has one explicit source of authority.
Generated state has one maintained synchronization path.
Production harness modules and tests are evaluated by ownership and behavior, not reduced to meet numerical line or module targets.
Scientific production code, scientific evidence, and research documentation remain outside cleanup unless they are direct control-plane artifacts.
inventory_limitations: The inventory was recomputed from the clean isolated base after adding only harness.control-plane-cleanup; it excludes every uncommitted primary-workspace change.
A structural status or path classification does not itself prove that an individual file has or lacks a live consumer.
No retention, deletion, compatibility, dependency, scientific, activation, protected-operation, or human-acceptance decision is executed by this report.
Git history is the proposed historical retention mechanism, but deletion remains unavailable until the Task is explicitly activated.
